question:
One of the four words in bold in the given sentence is incorrectly spelt. Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

The detectives uncovered a conspirasy to overthrow the government.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"conspirasy"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"conspiracy"**.

 
 
• **Meaning:** A secret plan by a group to do something unlawful or harmful. (साजिश)
 
• **Example:** The conspiracy was uncovered before the criminals could execute their plan.
 
 
 
• The correct spelling **"conspiracy"** has the same meaning as mentioned above. (साजिश)
 
 
• **Example:** He was accused of being part of a conspiracy to commit fraud.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Overthrow** (गिराना): The act of removing someone from power, typically by force.

 
 
• **Example:** The rebels planned to overthrow the existing government.
 
 
 
• **Uncovered** (खोज निकाला): To reveal or discover something that was hidden.
 
 
• **Example:** The journalists uncovered a major corruption scandal.
 
 
 
• **Detectives** (जासूस): Professionals who investigate crimes and gather evidence.
 
 
• **Example:** The detectives worked tirelessly to solve the case.
